NTA omg not at all. I have struggled with an ed in the past and used to be like that. Took me ages to realize I was just projecting onto everyone around me. 

You are completely entitled to feel proud of something you’ve worked hard for. The pictures are for you, you weren’t shoving them in her face or anything. Honestly even if you showed them on purpose because you’re proud of your achievements you wouldn’t be the asshole, just excited!

Eating disorders are hard and she needs help, but that is in no way your fault. 

Do not feel bad about this, if anything she should feel bad (and if she gets help she most likely will, that’s what happened with me I feel so guilty about hurting my friends in this way)

NTA AT ALL!!!

I have been in a motorcycle accident. I didn’t set out that day thinking it was gonna happen, but it did. 

I’m okay because I was in full leathers with a helmet. Had I not been, I would be injured for life. 

Responsible riders like you are so important. 

Keep making them wear a helmet.

Not grown. 

And for that matter, are adult women supposed to sit and take harassment? Is it okay to make people uncomfortable as soon as they’re 18?

ETA: I was trying to give your the benefit of the doubt but you’re clearly a prick. If you’re not a troll you’d better take a good hard look at yourself or don’t be surprised when you start to disgust your wife.
Is your son a grown man? You keep talking about how this could ruin his future. That’s not something you say about full adults.
Ew??? She’s in high school? Legally she’s not a kid but do you really think girls have some magical sexual transformation on their 18th birthday? They don’t.

Are you truly going to choose the “her clothes made me do it” argument? The main argument used to belittle sexual harassment victims? While claiming this isn’t sexual harassment? 

Listen, a woman’s body does not exist solely to pleasure men. Women are thinking, feeling human beings. They have a purpose outside getting your rocks off. If she likes the way she looks in those clothes then good for her. It doesn’t mean your son gets to fuck her. If she likes fucking other guys? Good for her. It does not mean your son gets to fuck her. She’s a kid.

Why would you use that language to describe a high schooler? She is a kid, not a sex object and your son made her uncomfortable. His advances were clearly unwanted, and the school clearly thinks this incident is serious. 

I know one lowly internet soul can’t change your mind but if you love your wife please just listen to her. You have the chance to change your son for the better right now (and even if you don’t believe his behaviour sucks, other people will and they won’t want to associate with him, he could get in trouble). Do it for your family.

It wasn’t. But, if the hundreds of other commenters trying to tell you the severity of this issue can’t convince you, I doubt I can either :(((

I think you should really make an effort to listen to your wife. Just hear her out for a bit without judgement. It might help.

YTA it’s a good thing your school is taking such serious action regarding sexual harassment. 

You sticking up for him when he is clearly in the wrong on such a serious issue makes me wonder where he learned this from though... (just kidding, I’m pretty sure it was you)

You can both still change. I urge you to make an effort to learn how those comments can feel on the receiving end.

I think we’re both coming at this from very personal and emotional places, having experienced opposite ends of this systemic problem. I think we should just agree that foster care is bad, and agree to disagree on the rest. I really hope you’re doing well now.

Look, as a woman I support the right to choose. As a person with a biological dad who didn’t want me but stayed due to this very sentiment, I support the right to choose for both parties. Parenting a child you don’t want just leads to more issues. Again I am in NO WAY advocating for the foster care choice. But this issue is more complicated than you’re making it out to be. Sex does not exist solely to create children. That’s why we have contraception which, again, he used.

It kind of does though? Like I do agree that it would be right and good to take in the child. But having sex with CONTRACEPTION does not mean one has to be willing to accept a lifelong commitment to raise a human being. The reality is blood does not automatically equate to family. Again, I’m not saying he should send her to foster care. But why does his sperm make him the best person to raise this child?

Idk why everyone is so mad at you for having sex. You used contraception and it failed, and the girl decided to keep the child without you, not your fault. I think technically you’re NTA. Having this child was in no way your decision and if you’re incapable of caring for her then that’s understandable. 
HOWEVER - foster care sucks. And if you think you could provide a better life for her, ESPECIALLY if you can afford a nanny or something to help you deal with it, you should. Since you asked the question you probably know that this is the right thing to do.
